purpose: Canonical companion-engine runtime payload for the Fredo installer (Spec #3158, totality restored in #3172). This is the single machine-readable list of payload DLL names: .opencode/scripts/stage-engine-payload.ps1 stages exactly this set and scans the import AND delay-import tables of every one of them, and .opencode/scripts/verify-installer-payload.ps1 asserts the set inside the produced installer. Hand-authored from the shipped Cargo feature set (dynamic-link, Vulkan-only, mtmd) - never scraped from a build directory. importClosure.roots MUST be the literal all-staged (a hand-picked root subset is refused) and forbiddenImportPrefixes names the module prefixes no staged DLL may import.
